summary: PBDB holds dated Antarctic fossil plants (2,130 records, 35 Nothofagus), and GenBank/GBIF/OTL supply sequences, modern ranges and topology, but no dated phylogenies or paleoclimate data for the disjunct genera were found as repository datasets, so the ancestral-area test needs those compiled from papers.
next_step: Pick 5-10 disjunct genera, pull PBDB Antarctic occurrences at genus level, assemble dated phylogenies from published supplements, and state the vicariance versus Antarctic-source predictions in the pre-registration.
obstacles_confirmed: Antarctic plant fossils in PBDB are mostly indeterminate or higher-taxon records.
No repository deposit of dated southern-hemisphere plant phylogenies was found (DataCite hits 0).
